postcode_field: pcds (variable-length, index 2) — space split: left=district, left+space+char1=sector

columns_used.doterm: index 4 — termination date; non-empty rows excluded
columns_used.rgn25cd: index 17 — region (England only; blank for Wales/Scotland/NI)
columns_used.npark16cd: index 28 — national park (included where any postcodes fall within)

rural_urban_grouping.urban: EW 2021 codes UN1/UF1 (Urban nearer/further from major town); Scotland codes 1/2/3
rural_urban_grouping.rural: EW 2021 codes RLF1/RLN1/RSF1/RSN1 (Larger/Smaller rural further/nearer); Scotland codes 4/5/6
rural_urban_grouping.other: NI (ruc21ind blank in ONSPD for BT postcodes) or unrecognised

bt_coverage: BT included: 50,116 live postcodes across 80 districts and 269 sectors. No boundary geometry in v6 — data is present but cannot be drawn on the map.
